verdict.rationale: Skyfire's own documented interfaces are an Agent Dashboard, a Playground, REST APIs, SDKs, and an official MCP server. None of the evidence describes a first-party natural-language command interface. The MCP server only lets an external agent drive Skyfire through tool calls, so any natural-language layer comes from the user's own agent. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
